credential_tables.name: auth_credentials
credential_tables.reason: the credential variables a first-party or provider login reads

credential_tables.name: provider_selection
credential_tables.reason: the switches that move Claude Code off the subscription to another provider, with their companions

credential_tables.name: skip_provider_auth
credential_tables.reason: the switches that skip a provider login

credential_tables.name: anthropic_secrets
credential_tables.reason: Claude Code's own list of Anthropic secrets (with their INPUT_ forms)

credential_tables.name: session_tokens
credential_tables.reason: the session tokens a hosted or claimed session authenticates with

credential_tables.name: claimed_session_tokens
credential_tables.reason: the tokens a claimed spare session is handed

credential_tables.name: api_key_pair
credential_tables.reason: the API key and bearer token

credential_tables.name: bedrock_wizard
credential_tables.reason: the Bedrock setup wizard's AWS credentials: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK is stripped by auth_credentials; the general AWS keys are the worker's tools' own cloud login and reach no model once the CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ switches are gone

credential_tables.name: tool_secret_scrub
credential_tables.reason: the secrets Claude Code scrubs from its own tool children (package registries, CI, cloud, webhooks): tool credentials, not a model login

credential_tables.name: provider_endpoints
credential_tables.reason: the base URLs that point Claude Code at another endpoint, with their selections and companions

notes.result.modelUsage: Per-model totals for every model call made through the query pipeline during this query() call - main loop, Task subagents, sidechains, and internal calls such as compaction and Workflow agents. Cumulative across turns in streaming-input sessions: each result carries the running total so far, so read the latest result rather than summing across results. Internal helper calls outside the query pipeline (e.g. the permission classifier, token-count probes) are excluded; crash/startup-error results may carry zeroed usage, a resumed or forked session continues from the totals its transcript saved,
notes.result.usage: MAIN AGENT LOOP ONLY - excludes Task subagent, sidechain, and auxiliary model calls, and is per-turn in streaming-input sessions. Prefer modelUsage for token/cost accounting.

claude_code.source: the zod schema of the SDK stream messages embedded in the binary (print mode, stream JSON)

credential_tables.name: auth_env
credential_tables.reason: the auth variables Codex reads instead of its stored login

credential_tables.name: bedrock_provider
credential_tables.reason: the Bedrock provider credentials: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK is stripped (a model key both CLIs name); the general AWS keys are the worker's tools' own cloud login, and Codex selects Bedrock only through the model_provider of the owner-prepared profile

credential_tables.name: exec_server_scrub
credential_tables.reason: the secrets the exec server withholds from remote requests: its OpenAI and Codex names are stripped by prefix, the cloud names are tool credentials

credential_tables.name: shell_env_scrub
credential_tables.reason: the default exclusions of Codex's shell environment policy for its tool children: its Codex and OpenAI names are stripped by prefix, NODE_REPL_AUTH_TOKEN is a tool's own

codex.source: the serde names of codex-exec's ThreadEvent (tag 'type') and its payload structs, packed in the binary's literals; the strings show field names, not which are always present, so every usage field is marked optional

usage_limit.source: protocol error Display: the message, then ' Try again at <local time>.' (same day: %-I:%M %p; else %b %-d<suffix>, %Y %-I:%M %p) or ' Try again later.' with no reset
